metrics.label: Commits
metrics.command: git -C dev-utils rev-list --count c2ebd66

metrics.label: Non-merge commits
metrics.command: git -C dev-utils rev-list --count --no-merges c2ebd66

metrics.label: First commit
metrics.command: git -C dev-utils log --reverse --format=%as c2ebd66 | head -1

metrics.label: Latest commit
metrics.command: git -C dev-utils log -1 --format=%as c2ebd66

metrics.label: Active days
metrics.command: git -C dev-utils log --format=%as c2ebd66 | sort -u | wc -l

metrics.label: Commits on origin/dev at 84caf0b (integration branch)
metrics.command: git -C dev-utils rev-list --count 84caf0b

metrics.label: Tags reachable from the ref
metrics.command: git -C dev-utils tag --merged c2ebd66 | wc -l

metrics.label: Test-tree files (tests, harness and fixtures)
metrics.command: git -C dev-utils ls-tree -r --name-only c2ebd66 | grep -cE '(^|/)(tests?|__tests__)/|\.test\.[a-z]+$|_test\.[a-z]+$|(^|/)test_[^/]*\.py$|(^|/)test-[^/]*\.(mjs|js|sh)$'

metrics.label: Python test cases (def test_…)
metrics.command: git -C dev-utils grep -I -c -E '^\s*(async\s+)?def test_' c2ebd66 -- '*.py' | awk -F: '{s+=$NF} END {print s+0}'

metrics.label: CI workflows
metrics.command: git -C dev-utils ls-tree -r --name-only c2ebd66 -- .github/workflows | wc -l

metrics.label: Lines of Python, excluding tests
metrics.command: git -C dev-utils grep -I -c '' c2ebd66 -- '*.py' | awk -F: '$2 !~ "(^|/)(tests?|__tests__)/|\\.test\\.[a-z]+$|_test\\.[a-z]+$|(^|/)test_[^/]*\\.py$|(^|/)test-[^/]*\\.(mjs|js|sh)$" {s+=$NF} END {print s+0}'

metrics.label: Lines of Python in test files
metrics.command: git -C dev-utils grep -I -c '' c2ebd66 -- '*.py' | awk -F: '$2 ~ "(^|/)(tests?|__tests__)/|\\.test\\.[a-z]+$|_test\\.[a-z]+$|(^|/)test_[^/]*\\.py$|(^|/)test-[^/]*\\.(mjs|js|sh)$" {s+=$NF} END {print s+0}'

metrics.label: Lines of Markdown (docs, skills, ledgers)
metrics.command: git -C dev-utils grep -I -c '' c2ebd66 -- '*.md' | awk -F: '{s+=$NF} END {print s+0}'

metrics.label: Commit authors other than the owner (count only)
metrics.command: git -C dev-utils log --format=%aN c2ebd66 | sort -u | grep -vixF -e 'bradleydb' -e 'bradley' | wc -l

metrics.label: dev-loop findings on the bus, live + archive
metrics.command: git -C dev-utils show c2ebd66:dev/FEEDBACK.md c2ebd66:dev/FEEDBACK-archive.md | grep -oE '^## F-[0-9]+' | sort -u | wc -l

metrics.label: Fixes carrying an independent `Judge:` line
metrics.command: git -C dev-utils show c2ebd66:dev/FEEDBACK.md c2ebd66:dev/FEEDBACK-archive.md | grep -c '^Judge:'

metrics.label: Fixes that name the design they replace (`Redesign:`)
metrics.command: git -C dev-utils show c2ebd66:dev/FEEDBACK.md c2ebd66:dev/FEEDBACK-archive.md | grep -c '^Redesign:'

metrics.label: Deliberate re-pins to the skill spec
metrics.command: git -C dev-utils log c2ebd66 --format=%s | grep -ci 're-pin'

metrics.label: Python source
metrics.command: git -C dev-utils grep -I -c '' c2ebd66 -- '*.py' ':!tests/' | awk -F: '{s+=$NF} END {print s}'

metrics.label: Merged pull requests
metrics.command: gh pr list -R BradleyDB/dev-utils --state merged --limit 2000 --json number --jq length

metrics.label: Merged PRs by someone other than the owner (count only)
metrics.command: gh pr list -R BradleyDB/dev-utils --state merged --limit 2000 --json author --jq '[.[] | select(.author.login != "BradleyDB")] | length'
